sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: The service interface for bounded knowledge and evidence operations.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Like a counter with defined request forms, it offers specific operations instead of unrestricted storage access.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: A caller requests an evidence bundle or an authorized assertion by ID.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: REST exposes stable contract operations; adapters derive authenticated access context.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Consumers can use knowledge without depending on graph storage internals.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Workspace and source-derived authorization apply to reads. This documentation site calls none of these endpoints.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.body: Open the checked implementation, tests, contracts and migrations below. These links identify evidence, not new verification.
